content.summary: This investigation conducted during the 29th Indian Antarctic Expedition examines key environmental science phenomena in polar terrain around Maitri and Schirmacher Oasis. The study records baseline scientific parameters and contributes to long-term monitoring of environmental changes in Antarctica.
